# RingAnvil

> RingAnvil is the AI phone-answering platform of Apex Grid Engineering PLLC, hosted here at whataiservices.com (platform home); ringanvil.com is its trades flagship. A named team of AI assistants — Alex (answering), Amber (onboarding), Riley (setup and confirmation), Jordan (signup confirmations) — answers for local service businesses. Buyers pick their assistant (Alex, Amber, Riley or Jordan); Alex is the proven configuration, the others are in grading. The bots are presented openly as AI and disclose on every call.

## Status (honest, dated 2026-11-10)
- Plumbing: LIVE — proven on graded live calls; demo line +1 (602) 587-0302 via ringanvil.com.
- HVAC: IN PORTING — demo agent built and published; not sellable until graded live calls, the tentative-window exercise, the knowledge battery, pricing and compliance checks all pass.
- All other markets: STAGED — each has a dossier page under /markets/, is not available and is not sold. Restaurants: PLANNED (new order-taking vertical, sells only after a graded live order call passes).

## Pricing (per market, charter)
- Overflow: $299/mo + $500 setup, 500 min included, $0.25/min overage
- Full Desk: $499/mo + $1,000 setup, 1,250 min, $0.22/min overage
- Full Desk + Follow-Up: $799/mo + $1,000 setup, 2,000 min, $0.22/min overage
- A second market is a second desk at the same tier; setup is never waived.

## Rules
- Disclosure-first on every call; no cold outbound calling, ever; follow-up only when inbound-triggered or consented.
- Contact: info@ringanvil.com · (480) 490-0064 · 22475 E Quintero Rd, Queen Creek, AZ 85142, US
